title: EvoJump: A Comprehensive Framework for Evolutionary Ontogenetic Analysis
description: EvoJump models ontogenetic development as a jump-diffusion process sweeping across a fixed analytical plane (the laser plane), yielding dynamic cross-sectional views of phenotypic distributions across a developmental timeline. It bundles data ingestion and QC (DataCore), stochastic process modeling across seven processes including jump-diffusion, OU, compound-Poisson, fractional Brownian motion, CIR, and Lévy processes (JumpRope), cross-sectional distribution analysis (LaserPlane), trajectory visualization and animation (TrajectoryVisualizer), population-level evolutionary sampling (EvolutionSampler), and a broad statistical analysis engine (AnalyticsEngine).
